verdict.rationale: Render documents an official CLI that manages existing services and datastores, validates render.yaml Blueprints, and runs non-interactively in CI/CD. No evidence shows a CLI command that scaffolds a new project and deploys it in one step. Documented deploy paths are git-push-based or the MCP server's trigger_deploy for an existing service, so the CLI's service management is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Use the Render CLI to manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal
The CLI also supports [non-interactive use](#non-interactive-mode) in scripts and CI/CD.
